long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Nothing is in my paws, so I need clay before I can shape anything, and the clay bank is where it comes from.
One piece of clay in my paws is what the workbench needs, and I claim it before anyone else does.
The clay has to go where things get shaped, and the workbench is mine.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object, and I will keep it where I can see it.
The moon hides its colour from me, and I want to know why before anyone tells me.
The moon's colour is a mystery I intend to solve on my own terms.
The telescope is mine, so I will put it on record.

today.reason: The shaping step could not be carried out with empty paws, so I have added the trip to the clay bank before it.
